state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing game for all ages (children and adults), online like Minecraft, web now and a mobile app later. Parents are responsible when they let a child play; no parental supervision is required. Built 100% by AI; today only the owner and one child play.
state.plan: Move to one player per Google account: the signed-in person is the main player; optional extra players on a shared device (e.g. a parent's child). Consent v3 is shown once to every account.
facts: Player and profile names today are picked from a fixed list; no free text anywhere players can see each other.
Free-text names would need a word filter and a way to rename offensive names before online play; there is no moderation console (parked until outsiders play).

Google accounts already have a minimum age set by Google (13 in most countries; younger children can only have Family Link accounts). Children under that age would play as an extra player inside an adult's account.

Asking an age question on the consent screen adds a step and collects an age-related answer; Vietnamese personal data law treats children's data specially, and the consent text is self-written, not reviewed by a lawyer.
Accounts allow at most 3 profiles today; extra players share the account owner's Google sign-in.

player_names.instructions: In this plan, how should players get their display name?

criteria.list_only: Keep choosing from the fixed list for everyone for now; revisit free text with the moderation work before outsiders play.
criteria.free_text_adults: Let the main player type a name with a word filter now.

age_question.instructions: Should consent v3 ask the main player to confirm they are at least 13 years old?

criteria.checkbox_13: Add one checkbox 'I am 13 or older; younger children play as an extra player in a parent's account', storing only that it was ticked with the consent.
criteria.rely_on_google: Ask nothing; rely on Google's account age limit and state in the consent text that children play under a parent's account.

max_players.instructions: How many players (main plus extra) should one account allow?

criteria.raise_5: Raise to 5 in total for larger families.
